text: Fixed. X_run's projection is now computed once as proj_run_unwhitened above both voxel loops (R/fmri_lm_runwise.R:388) and reused at :418 (parallel) and :492 (sequential). Measured on T=300, 2 runs, V=2000 voxelwise AR(1): 4.95s -> 2.98s, i.e. 2.48 -> 1.49 ms/voxel, a 1.66x speedup. All voxelwise tests pass unchanged (test_voxelwise_ar, test_voxelwise_comprehensive, test_voxelwise_ar_robust, test_runwise_ar_fit). The per-voxel p x p XtXinv_list storage noted in the original bead is untouched and remains open as a memory concern.
